engineName.description:
The name of the search engine to be overridden, only applies to OpenSearch
engines
engineName.title: Engine Name

overridesAppIdv2.description:
The identifier of the config search engine to be overridden. This field is for
search-config-v2 support.
overridesAppIdv2.title: Config search engine identifier to Override (search-config-v2)

overridesId.description:
The identifier of the app-provided add-on to be overridden. Should be of the
format example@search.mozilla.org. This field is used for the original search
configuration, and for some of the early Firefox versions that support
search-config-v2.
overridesId.title: Add-on Id to Override (original search config)

thirdPartyId.description:
The identifier of the third party add-on which will override the app provided
one. Should be of the format example@foo. If the third party engine is an
OpenSearch engine, then this must be opensearch@search.mozilla.org
thirdPartyId.title: Third-party Add-on Id

urls.description:
An array of URL sets which must be matched (with the add-on's manifest settings)
to allow the override

search_form.description: Unsupported on Firefox at this time
search_form.title: search_form

urls.title: URLs
